messages.text: A CHARGER? Absolutely not. What happened to the one you have?!
My charger's cable split and won't charge anymore
Tape exists. Have you heard of tape?!
I use my laptop for every lecture and my shift scheduling, 6 days a week
…okay, fine, that one was good. But did you even LOOK at other options?
I checked a refurbished one for $25 but it's not compatible with my model
